info.title: API.SH: Ashley
info.description: The Ashley API from API.SH: public Ashley data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Suggestions for a partial query as the shop's search box shows them: search terms, categories and products (SKU, name, link, image, rating).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ashley-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The shop's category tree: ids (usable as `category` in search), names and product counts, from the top or below one category, one to three levels deep.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ashley-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Category id to start from (default: the top), e.g. furniture.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product by item number or link, priced and stocked for a ZIP code: name, link, brand, color, price and list price, rating and review counts, description, features, fabric, overall and detailed dimensions, weight, status, assembly, category, breadcrumb, images, dimension drawing, swatches, variants and their attributes, flags, promotions and delivery availability (status, method, message, earliest date, quantity), plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ashley-product

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Item number, e.g. 3100438 (the last part of the link). Or pass url.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: US ZIP code the prices and delivery are for (default 10001); prices differ by region.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product's customer reviews (with reviews of its other colors and sizes unless related=false). Each review: id, rating, title, text, date, purchase date, reviewer first name and last initial with nickname, location, age range and profile answers when given, recommend answer, incentivized and staff flags, helpful votes, photos, responses and the reviewed item. Filter by star ratings, review topics (values in `filters`) or text; five sort orders. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ashley-reviews

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Star ratings to keep, e.g. 5 or 4,5.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Review topics to keep, e.g. comfort (values in `filters`).

parameters.name: related
parameters.description: false: only this exact item's reviews.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Ashley furniture by keywords, or browse a category, with the shop's filters (facet values from the response) and its sort orders, priced for a ZIP code. Each product: SKU, name, link, images, brand, color, description, price and list price for the ZIP, rating, review count, dimensions, weight, flags and its color variants with prices, plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with counts and the matching categories. A keyword the shop sends to a category page browses that category (`redirected_to`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ashley-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Optional when category is set.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from /ashley/v1/categories or a /c/... link), e.g. sofas-and-couches; alone it browses the category.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as name:value;name:value (several values of one name joined by |), names and values as in `facets`, e.g. facetNavColor:Gray|Brown.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: US ZIP code the prices and delivery are for (default 10001); prices differ by region.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
